section_desc.default: Engineered for researchers and institutions requiring ultra-high molecular weight DNA resolution, direct epigenetic modifications, and GPU-accelerated basecalling pipelines.

card1_desc.default: Direct single-molecule sequencing of ultra-long native DNA and native RNA strands. Zero PCR amplification bias, real-time base modification calling, and phased telomere-to-telomere genomic assemblies.

card2_desc.default: End-to-end computational genomics run on dedicated NVIDIA GPU clusters. From Dorado Super-Accuracy basecalling to Sniffles2 structural variant discovery, phased diploid assemblies, and methylome profiling.

card3_desc.default: Democratizing genomic knowledge by training the next generation of sequencing scientists. We partner with universities, government labs, and medical centers to stand up self-sufficient long-read genomics hubs.

training_1_desc.default: HMW DNA extraction, barcoding protocols, and flowcell priming diagnostics.

training_2_desc.default: Turnkey MinION starter deployments and standardized wet-lab curriculum.

training_3_desc.default: Immersive 12-week genomic data analysis residencies with certified competency.
